author: jtraglia
content:
Hey <@&1417820113981145228> we need to decide which approach to take here. This is the bug we talked about at ACDT this week in the CL breakout (https://forkcast.org/calls/acdt/098/?breakout=cl#t=80). There are two proposals:
* [Do not pay for old payloads](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5694)
* [Settle builder payment before parent requests](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5695)

author: jtraglia
content: Personally, I like the 2nd one (#5695) best. Can anyone think of a reason why it would be bad?
